newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$5 bln in NCDs on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$5 bln in NCDs on Friday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Friday it would issue T$5 billion in three-month negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day.
Bids would close at 3.00 pm (0700 GMT), a central bank official said.

During a sustained stock rally in March and April, the central bank repeatedly issued NCDs, a move widely seen as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts said had been fuelling the sizzling stock market.
The central bank has confirmed that it was responding to the liquidity sitution but denied that it was acting directly in response to the stock market bull run.
